terms.gloss: accustom; become accustomed, get used to; in the perfect, be in the habit of
evidence: Cic. Quinct. 87: quem ipse prōcūrātōrem relinquere anteā cōnsuēsset (Lewis & Short)

terms.gloss: accustom; grow accustomed to (+ ablative or dative)
evidence: Cic. de Or. 3.58: hominēs labōre adsiduō et cotīdiānō adsuētī (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: quem ipse prōcūrātōrem relinquere anteā cōnsuēsset
phrases.english: whom he himself had been in the habit of leaving as his agent before

phrases.latin: hominēs labōre adsiduō et cotīdiānō adsuētī
phrases.english: men used to constant daily toil
